answers.why: The title 'God of Israel' identifies the nation's God speaking to Baruch.
'God of Israel' names the nation's God announcing judgment on Egypt.
Israel is promised deliverance from captivity and return from the nations.
'God of Israel' identifies the nation's God pronouncing judgment on Moab.
Moab mocked Israel, the neighboring people addressed in this national judgment.
Israel's heirs are invoked against Ammon's occupation of Gad's cities.
Gad is the tribal territory occupied by Ammon and its people.
Israel will dispossess those who occupied its territory after judgment on Ammon.
Israel is the scattered people attacked by the kings of Assyria and Babylon.
'God of Israel' refers to the God of the people scattered by Assyria and Babylon.
Israel will be restored to its homeland after being scattered by foreign kings.
Israel's collective iniquity will be forgiven when God pardons the surviving remnant.
Judah's collective sins will be forgiven alongside Israel's iniquity.
'Holy One of Israel' names the nation's God against whom Babylon acted proudly.
